name: CerebroHive EIOS
install: cd OPC/cerebro-hive-website && corepack pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && { [ -f apps/studio/.env.local ] || printf 'NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8900/api/v1\n' > apps/studio/.env.local; }

terminals.name: studio-web
terminals.command: cd OPC/cerebro-hive-website/apps/studio && corepack pnpm exec next dev -p 3401
terminals.description: CerebroHive Studio Next.js dev server (http://localhost:3401). The primary web app; depends on transpiled @cerebro/* workspace packages.
